meta.source: scripts/build-itaewon.mjs, at 1/4 on the real place: Itaewon-ro, Noksapyeong-daero, Bogwang-ro, Usadan-ro, Sinheung-ro, Sowol-ro, Seobinggo-ro and Gyeongnidan-gil (Hoenamu-ro) from OpenStreetMap (scripts/data/itaewon-osm.json, gyeongnidan-osm.json); Namsan with its cable car (scripts/build-namsan.mjs). The World Food Street, Yongmaru Market's lanes and every building and shop are made up; the museums are at the real 1/4.. The city wall on Namsan and Gwanghuimun: scripts/build-namsan-wall.mjs (OpenStreetMap, scripts/data/namsan-wall-osm.json)

landmarks.plazaWhy: The summit plaza's level top follows the real plaza (OSM, scripts/data/namsan-osm.json summit) at 1/4, its farthest part along each angle plus 1.5 m, never under 12 m (the tower's terrace). plazaApprox: angles (of 120) where it is a hull of the buildings and footways, as OSM has no area there.
trailWhy: the summit trail: carried on 6.9 m straight at the tower, from the old plaza's edge (17.9 m) to the real one

landmarks.why: 1/4 on OpenStreetMap's line (Yozi 2026-11-19). Stations 8.4 m across to hold two game-size cabins (real 1/4: lower ~8 x 9 m, upper ~4 x 5 m). Upper station 2.3 m sideways off the city wall trail; pylons from OSM's two middle points; lower station 0 m off Sopa-ro.
